atoms.reason: Unanimous (A/B/C) and the keystone of the integration: without a `gemini` branch in `build_vlm`, none of the other atoms are reachable. Names the exact file, function, target class, and an isinstance test — fully actionable. Standard factory dispatch, low cost, medium reversibility. No concerns.

Consensus and concrete: `gemini-2.5-flash`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`, and `timeout_seconds=config.timeout_seconds` are all valid, testable defaults. Minor watch-item — keep the factory default as a true fallback so it does not silently diverge from the YAML in atom config_update_yaml_vlm_block; the 'defaults or when specified in config' phrasing already covers this, so no penalty. Assertable via `provider.model`.

Strong design invariant: a side-effect-free constructor keeps factory construction, config validation, and tests offline and deterministic (highest risk_reduction in the set). High reversibility. Slight specificity deduction because 'assert no network call by mocking' proves a negative — pin it concretely (e.g. patch the SDK client/transport and assert not-called) rather than a loose mock.

Consensus, fully reversible, and wires the feature end-to-end through both example and live-webcam configs. Stores only an env-var name (`GEMINI_API_KEY`), not a secret, so no credential-exposure concern. `test_example_config_drives_providers` gives a clean regression anchor. Ensure the YAML values stay the single source of truth vs the factory defaults in factory_gemini_defaults.

penalties: magic sentinel thresholds (min_risk_score=1.01, max_normality_score=-0.01) silently assume risk/normality scores are bounded in [0,1]; if any score can exceed that range the gate misfires, and intent is non-obvious to a reader
atoms.reason: Achieving person/animal-only triggering purely through `VlmGateConfig` without touching `_trigger_reason` is the right call — zero code change, fully config-reversible, and precisely specified. Accepted, but the out-of-band sentinels (1.01 / -0.01) are the one real fragility: they encode 'never trigger by risk/normality' via assumed score bounds. Document that assumption (or expose explicit disable flags) and pair with gate_extract_config_profile to centralize them. Test coverage across positive and negative event types is well chosen.

Consensus and unambiguous: the listed classes are exactly the COCO animal set, so completeness is verifiable. Module-level `frozenset` is the idiomatic, O(1)-lookup choice and reads cleanly. Parametrized tests per class make coverage explicit and regression-proof. High reversibility, low cost.

Sound, low-friction strategy: extend the existing `test_providers.py`, `test_config.py`, and `test_vlm_gate.py` rather than spawning parallel suites — keeps discovery and conventions intact. Impact is organizational rather than functional, hence the modest impact score, but it materially lowers regression risk and is trivially simple. Aligns one-to-one with the testable atoms above.

Single-proposal (B) but a genuinely additive refactor: a named `PERSON_ANIMAL_ONLY_GATE_CONFIG` in `gate.py` removes duplication between tests and wiring and, crucially, gives the fragile sentinel values from gate_config_person_animal_only one documented home — directly mitigating that atom's main weakness. The 'future live wiring' rationale is mildly speculative (YAGNI), but the test-reuse and centralization benefits stand on their own. Low cost, high reversibility.
